title: COUNSEL — BEDROOM NIGHT
lessons: The player opens ZYN.com to look around and is stopped by registration and age verification before reaching the product pages.
The player already uses classic ZYN and sees the newer ZYN Ultra line promoted as a higher-strength, hydro-boosted extension with a different can.

text: The player opens ZYN.com to look around and is stopped by registration and age verification before reaching the product pages.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I just wanted to see what flavors there are.

entry-first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Before product content is displayed, the site requires verification that you are at least twenty-one years old and a current nicotine consumer.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You brought a lawyer to an age gate.

entry-first-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I was retained before the page loaded.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: What exactly are they verifying?

entry-first-6.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Identity and age through third-party verification. The company's 2026 regulatory materials state that the system may match submitted information against government databases.

choice-first.speaker: COUNSEL
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: Fine. I actually like that they verify instead of using a birthday dropdown.
That is a lot of personal information just to browse a website.
If I need to register before I can even look, I am leaving.

first-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The record will reflect that you prefer a meaningful age gate over a decorative one.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That is the least romantic sentence anyone has ever said to me.

first-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I am comfortable with that characterization.

first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The tradeoff is real. Access control requires more information than an honor-system date field.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the friction is intentional.

first-2-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Correct.

first-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Then access terminates before the product content. No further action is required.
The player already uses classic ZYN and sees the newer ZYN Ultra line promoted as a higher-strength, hydro-boosted extension with a different can.

entry-return-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The word "Ultra" should not be construed as an emotional commitment.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I was going to ask if it just means stronger.

entry-return-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Not exclusively. The line uses a moister pouch, contains twenty pouches per can, includes a disposal compartment in the lid, and is offered in nine- and eleven-milligram strengths.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: There it is. Eleven.

entry-return-5.speaker: COUNSEL
text: As of August 21, 2026, FDA marketing authorization covers eleven ZYN Ultra products, including all submitted nine-milligram variants and one eleven-milligram variant. Additional eleven-milligram variants remained under review at that time.

choice-return.speaker: COUNSEL
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: The disposal lid and bigger can are actually useful changes.
"Ultra" still feels like escalation dressed up as an upgrade.
Higher nicotine strength is exactly what I do not want.

return-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Your approval is limited to the packaging and convenience changes. I have recorded it narrowly.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Thank you for protecting me from accidentally liking a lid too much.

return-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Scope matters.

return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Higher strength is part of the proposition. The other changes do not erase that fact.

return-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Then the higher-strength extension is inconsistent with your stated preference. Classic ZYN remains a separate line.
